title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 26
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 26: David and Abishai take Saul's spear and water jar, and David spares Saul again.

questions.text: In which hill did the Ziphites say David was hiding?
questions.explanation: The Ziphites came to Saul, saying, "Doesn't David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah?"

questions.text: What did David send out when Saul came after him into the wilderness?
questions.explanation: David sent out spies and understood that Saul had certainly come.

questions.text: Who said he would go down with David to Saul's camp?
questions.explanation: Abishai said, "I will go down with you."

questions.text: Where was Saul's spear while he lay sleeping?
questions.explanation: Saul lay sleeping within the place of the wagons, with his spear stuck in the ground at his head.

answers.text: Stuck in the ground at his head

questions.text: What did Abishai ask to do to Saul?
questions.explanation: Abishai asked to strike Saul with the spear to the earth at one stroke.

answers.text: Tie him up and bring him to David
Cut off the skirt of his robe

questions.text: What did David take from beside Saul's head?
questions.explanation: David took the spear and the jar of water from Saul's head.

answers.text: The spear and the jar of water

questions.text: Why did no one in Saul's camp wake up?
questions.explanation: No one awoke, for they were all asleep, because a deep sleep from Yahweh had fallen on them.

answers.text: A deep sleep from Yahweh had fallen on them
They had drunk too much wine
They had marched all day and night

questions.text: Why did David say Abner was worthy to die?
questions.explanation: David said Abner was worthy to die because he had not kept watch over his lord, Yahweh's anointed.

answers.text: He had tried to kill David
He had fled from the battle
He had not kept watch over the king
He had lied to Saul about David

questions.text: In verse 20, to what is the king of Israel's search compared?
questions.explanation: The king of Israel has come out to seek a flea, as when one hunts a partridge in the mountains.

answers.text: Chasing a deer in the forest
Hunting a partridge in the mountains
Catching a fox in the vineyard
Tracking a lion in the desert

questions.text: What did Saul confess to David?
questions.explanation: Saul said, "I have sinned. Return, my son David... Behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly."

answers.text: "I have sinned... I have played the fool"
